verdict.rationale: Square's API clearly supports date-based versioning — SDK calls can override the API version ("version: '2024-05-04'") and the MCP tool documents a SQUARE_VERSION pinning control — showing a live, explicit versioning scheme. However, no evidence in the pack shows a documented deprecation policy (timelines, sunset notices, migration guides) that would let an AI-native user reliably plan around version lifecycle changes. Missing for 10: an explicit deprecation/sunset policy document, version changelog, or migration guidance referenced anywhere in the evidence.
